text: 【央行对邮储银行予以警告、通报批评并罚款1743万元 因十项违法违规行为】中国人民银行发布银罚决字〔2026〕88号，对中国邮政储蓄银行股份有限公司予以警告、通报批评，没收违法所得0.02902万元，并罚款1743.3万元。违法行为包括违反金融统计、账户管理、银行卡收单、数据安全、反假货币等管理规定，以及占压财政存款或资金、未按规定履行客户身份识别义务、未按规定报送大额交易报告或可疑交易报告、与身份不明的客户进行交易等。
text_en: [PBOC Issues Warning and Public Reprimand to Postal Savings Bank and Fines It 17.43 Million Yuan for Ten Illegal and Non-compliant Acts] The People's Bank of China issued Yin Fa Jue Zi [2026] No. 88, issuing a warning and public reprimand to Postal Savings Bank of China Co., Ltd., confiscating illegal gains of 0.02902 million yuan, and imposing a fine of 17.433 million yuan. The illegal acts include violating regulations on financial statistics, account management, bank card acquiring, data security, and anti-counterfeit currency management, as well as occupying or withholding fiscal deposits or funds, failing to perform customer identity identification obligations as required, failing to submit large-value transaction reports or suspicious transaction reports as required, and conducting transactions with customers of unidentified identity.
